source.line:
The Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has released the BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026 Notification for 105 Food Safety Officer (FSO) vacancies under the Health Department, Bihar. As per Advertisement No. 29/2026, the online application process started on 25 September 2026 and will continue until 24 October 2026. Candidates with the prescribed educational qualifications can check the eligibility criteria, age limit, category-wise vacancies, salary, application fee, selection process and exam pattern before applying.
BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026: Overview
Candidates can check the key details of the Bihar Food Safety Officer recruitment in the table below.
Particulars	Details
Recruiting Authority	Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC)
Department	Health Department, Bihar
Post Name	Food Safety Officer (FSO)
Advertisement Number	29/2026
Total Vacancies	105
Application Mode	Online
Application Start Date	25 September 2026
Last Date to Apply	24 October 2026
Selection Process	Computer-Based Test and Document Verification
Job Location	Bihar
Pay Level	Level 6
Grade Pay	₹4,200
Official Website	btsc.bihar.gov.in
BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
The official notification contains information about the available vacancies, educational qualifications, age limit, application fee, examination pattern, reservation rules and document verification requirements. Candidates should read the notification carefully to confirm that they meet the eligibility conditions before applying.
BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
The online application process began on 25 September 2026. Candidates must complete the application and fee payment within the prescribed deadline.
Event	Date
Notification Advertisement No. 29/2026	September 2026
Online Application Begins	25 September 2026
Last Date to Apply Online	24 October 2026
Last Date for Required Documents	24 October 2026
CBT Exam Date	To be announced
BTSC FSO Vacancy 2026
BTSC has announced a total of 105 Food Safety Officer vacancies. The notification provides category-wise vacancy details, including horizontal reservation for women who are domiciled in Bihar.
